biotools.summary: Trackastra is a transformer-based cell-tracking tool for live-cell microscopy. It links already segmented cell instances across time by predicting associations between detections. It supports greedy tracking with or without cell divisions, optional ILP-based linking, pretrained tracking models, and export of tracked masks and lineage information in Cell Tracking Challenge format.

function.cmd: trackastra track --imgs images/ --masks masks/ --output-ctc tracked_ctc --output-edge-table edges.csv --model-pretrained general_2d --mode greedy
function.note: Link already segmented cell instances across a microscopy time series and produce tracked masks, lineage information and association edges.

function.cmd: trackastra track --imgs images/ --masks masks/ --output-ctc tracked_ctc --output-edge-table edges.csv --model-pretrained general_2d --mode greedy
function.note: Link already segmented cell instances across a microscopy time series and produce tracked masks, lineage information and association edges.
